name: Attovia Therapeutics, Inc.
summary: A clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing biotherapeutics for immune-mediated diseases using its ATTOBODY biologics platform. The company's lead candidate, ATTO-1310, targets interleukin-31 (IL-31), known as the 'itch cytokine,' for the treatment of chronic pruritic diseases including atopic dermatitis. Its pipeline also includes multi-specific candidates for other inflammatory diseases.
